version.approval_notes: Power Loader is an internal casework tool deployed by organisations through enterprise policy. Hosted demo with fictional pages and a forms library, plus a step-by-step guide: https://powerloader.surprisingly.ltd/try (in the sidebar's Settings, enter https://powerloader.surprisingly.ltd/demo/library/ and press Connect, then start a case and clip the demo pages). Full reviewer notes: https://powerloader.surprisingly.ltd/reviewers (permissions, CSP, no remote code, the privacy model download, and every vendored library file with its npm release and SHA-256, also shipped as vendor/SOURCES.tsv). To rebuild with Node 24.19.0 and pnpm 11.3.0: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build:ext (see REVIEWERS.md). Our own code in extension/ is not minified. Privacy policy: https://powerloader.surprisingly.ltd/privacy Requires Firefox 140+. No permanent host access; individual origins requested at runtime. Declares website content, personal, financial/payment and health data. Source archive includes build instructions and SOURCE.json. Transformers.js web entry is bundled with stable ONNX Runtime 1.30.0 using esbuild 0.27.2 to exclude its upstream prerelease runtime; vendor/BUNDLE.json records inputs. Other third-party files are unmodified npm releases.
